title: Siss
description: A command-line tool for applying duotone and halftone effects to video and still-image files. Version 1.0.0 introduces LLM-authored constraints files, luminance-curve gamma, ring symbol, loss-map output, dual-style split-view, and a co-creation workflow where natural-language scene descriptions become deterministic visual grammars.
